call_points.text: Rake availability remains an important factor to monitor after coal supply prioritisation to power.
Kutch clinker unit and CPP are targeted for H2FY27; grinding unit and WHR for H1FY28.
2 MMTPA grinding capacity at Surat was commissioned in Q2FY27.
Government capex has headroom, with 77% of planned state outlays yet to be deployed in H2FY27.
Management targets net debt at 2-2.5x EBITDA and expects to meet it in FY27.
Vadraj clinker and grinding units planned for phased commissioning between Q3FY27 and Q1FY28.
A bulk cement terminal at Viramgam, Gujarat, with about 1.5 million tons per annum handling capacity, is targeted for FY28.
Management estimates total cost inflation of about ₹200/t in April, which price increases do not fully cover.
Rake availability fell from 4.5 to 4 per day in March as rakes were diverted to power plants, and remains a problem.
Management declined to give a mathematical reconciliation of price hikes versus cost increases.
